nodes.title: Gate 2 H2 built (dc-r8-gate2-habit-children; branch claude/r8-habit-battery): one shared battery, tests/_habit-children.mjs, drives whole sessions through the real server path as served (currentLevel, the child's acts, gradeActs, nameOnRepeat(lessonEvidence), afterLevelBody, nextBody: the picker repeats keys, steers to a suspected mix-up, lifts the band, may switch family), naming forced ON inside the battery only (the grade is not passed through withNaming; NAMING_OFF untouched, nothing a child sees changes, no naming rule changed). Cells: every fade x pL (none, 0.3, 0.6, 0.9) x all eight door sequences after levels 1-3, the session's NAMING_LEVELS = 4 levels; after a miss the child does the solve (the evidence is the first decision's either way). Children per mode: blind, one random slip a level, the same slip every level for every slip in the mode's own list (tally: 8 ways of reading x counting slips, 20 pad slips; kon/place: 40 pad slips, ticks, 48 fixed drops, turns, dot nudges; kon/name: swaps, missed tap added last, the letter beside, a tap twice, 48 finger offsets), a constant answer for every value (tally 0-99, measure 0-180, draw every rim mark, say all 64 tap triples, find all 5 arcs), what I did last time, first/last/middle option, smaller/larger printed number, the printed number, the eight reading directions; holders listed with why (the kit's own signs). Statistic asserted: the worst fade, pooled over pL, doors and seeds (64 sessions a fade, 192 for a random child; a single cell holds 1-6 sessions, too few for a random child); the worst cell is reported. The tests r8-habit-battery-{stambh-tally,kon-place,kon-name} are the negative control: the per-goal 'every non-holder child under 1 in 10' assertion is node:test todo where it fails today (tally read, place measure and draw, name say); a separate always-running test asserts the known failures show. A generator memo (pure in the request fields generate reads) makes the gate sweep 11-18 s a file; a test checks it changes no served session. Reverse if: a judge finds a child missing from the battery (add her), or main rules a different statistic than the worst fade.

The habit battery, gate sweep (2 sessions a cell, 6 for random children, 1 for each constant over two pL values), naming forced on, before any H1/H3/H4 rule. stambh/tally read: what I typed last time 0.17 and 16 every time 0.13 at fade 1 (1.0 in single cells; the judge's 0.95 was from a model without focus steering), every other non-holder under 0.1; keep: no non-holder named (the only one-button habit named, '|' only with right totals, is the kit's second sign and listed as a holder). kon/place: measure sessions repeat a key in their first four levels in about 65% of sessions and every naming of a constant number or a fixed typing slip is a second sighting on the same key; constants 33-37, 43-47, 58-67, 73-77 named (worst 0.75 at fade 3); new: the same drop every level, 16-32 board px up or up-right (where vertex-off's band lies on nearly every served level, which all open clockwise), named 0.94 (measure) and 0.89 (draw); the judge's 'first key one row low' is 0.06 at the worst fade (0.5 in a cell). kon/name say: the same swap or missed tap added last 1.00, reading across the screen in any of eight directions 1.00 (the generator serves no say level where reading across puts the vertex in the middle), one random slip a level 0.15, constant taps 012/210 0.5; find: no non-holder named. Holders named: tally read 0.83, keep 1.0; measure other scale 1.0, vertex-off 1.0, always larger or inner 0 (served levels never tell them); draw always A 0.48 (fewer than half: reported); say vertex first or last 1.0, any order 0.58; find first letter 0.50, last letter 0 (the law names only the first-letter pick). Full sweep (HABIT_FULL=1: 10 sessions a cell, 30 random, 4 per constant over every pL): the same verdicts; tally what I typed last time 0.23 and 16 every time 0.19 at fade 1; measure 'first key one row low' 0.22 at fade 2 (the judge's 0.19), constants 48-62 and 68-77; say one random slip 0.15. Not measured: real children, sessions longer than four levels, a day of several sessions.
